
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20974754" title="发布于 2026-07-03 07:54">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理(4.Attention：模型是怎么看懂上下文的?)</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="o0d2yi" data-start="142" data-end="172">第四章 Attention(注意力机制)：模型是如何“看懂上下文”的？</h1>
<hr data-start="174" data-end="177">
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">最近正好有空,打算抽时间复盘总结一下这些年零零散散学习的AI知识.</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">下面是目录</p>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
<p data-start="188" data-end="217">在上一章中，我们知道 Transformer 做了三件事：</p>
<ol data-start="219" data-end="286">
<li data-section-id="11tfoy" data-start="219" data-end="238">把文字变成 Token（第二章）</li>
<li data-section-id="86s99s" data-start="239" data-end="265">把 Token 变成向量（Embedding）</li>
<li data-section-id="1ecxhm0" data-start="266" data-end="286">让模型在生成每个词时“回头看前文”</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="288" data-end="299">但这里有一个关键问题：</p>
<blockquote data-start="301" data-end="321">
<p data-start="303" data-end="321"><strong data-start="303" data-end="321">模型到底是怎么“回头看”的？</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="323" data-end="342">人类阅读一句话时，其实会自动做一件事,<strong>把重要信息记住，把不重要信息忽略。</strong></p>
<p data-start="365" data-end="368">例如：</p>
<blockquote data-start="370" data-end="389">
<p data-start="372" data-end="389">小明昨天去北京出差，今天他回来了。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="391" data-end="400">我们几乎不会犹豫：</p>
<blockquote data-start="402" data-end="412">
<p data-start="404" data-end="412">“他” = 小明</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="414" data-end="430">因为我们的大脑自动做了“关联”。</p>
<p data-start="432" data-end="468">Transformer 的 Attention，本质上就是在<strong>模拟这件事</strong>。</p>
<hr data-start="470" data-end="473">
<h1 data-section-id="1nthe5w" data-start="475" data-end="490">4.1 先举个例子~</h1>
<p data-start="492" data-end="511">我们举一个普通生活中的例子</p>
<hr data-start="513" data-end="516">
<h2 data-section-id="1g9isp5" data-start="518" data-end="528">图书馆找书</h2>
<p data-start="530" data-end="542">假设我们在图书馆找一本书：</p>
<blockquote data-start="544" data-end="559">
<p data-start="546" data-end="559">《Java 并发编程实战》</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="561" data-end="567">我们会怎么做？</p>
<p data-start="569" data-end="587">我们不会把整个图书馆的书都认真读一遍。</p>
<p data-start="589" data-end="592">我们会：</p>
<ul data-start="594" data-end="635">
<li data-section-id="fu8xwo" data-start="594" data-end="601">快速记住标题</li>
<li data-section-id="xqd1eb" data-start="602" data-end="619">找对应技术分类（Java / 并发）</li>
<li data-section-id="1vqqjr" data-start="620" data-end="635">忽略无关书籍（小说、历史）</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="637" data-end="644">然后我们会发现,某一排书架上面有相关类别.</p>
<p data-start="659" data-end="668">于是我们集中注意力,主要从那一排书架上去找这本书。</p>
<hr data-start="670" data-end="673">
<p data-start="675" data-end="697">Attention 其实做的事情完全一样,它不是“平均看所有信息”，而是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="717" data-end="739">
<p data-start="719" data-end="739"><strong data-start="719" data-end="739">给每一段信息分配不同的重要性权重</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="741" data-end="744">
<h1 data-section-id="1yqflao" data-start="746" data-end="757">4.2 在请出我们的小明</h1>
<p data-start="759" data-end="769">我们继续用经典例子：</p>
<blockquote data-start="771" data-end="790">
<p data-start="773" data-end="790">小明昨天去北京出差，今天他回来了。</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="792" data-end="800">现在模型要预测：</p>
<blockquote data-start="802" data-end="807">
<p data-start="804" data-end="807">“他”到底是谁?</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="809" data-end="812">
<p data-start="814" data-end="823">模型会做一件事情：</p>
<p data-start="825" data-end="844">它会把前面的 Token 全部拿出来：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>小明<br>昨天<br>去<br>北京<br>出差<br>今天</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="876" data-end="884">然后问一个问题：</p>
<blockquote data-start="886" data-end="905">
<p data-start="888" data-end="905">哪些 Token 和“他”最相关？</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="907" data-end="910">
<p data-start="912" data-end="924">我们用人类方式模拟一下：</p>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="926" data-end="1031">
<thead data-start="926" data-end="941">
<tr data-start="926" data-end="941"><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="926" data-end="934" data-col-size="sm">Token</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="934" data-end="941" data-col-size="sm">相关性</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="960" data-end="1031">
<tr data-start="960" data-end="974">
<td data-start="960" data-end="965" data-col-size="sm">小明</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="965" data-end="974">⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="975" data-end="986">
<td data-start="975" data-end="980" data-col-size="sm">昨天</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="980" data-end="986">⭐⭐</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="987" data-end="996">
<td data-start="987" data-end="991" data-col-size="sm">去</td>
<td data-start="991" data-end="996" data-col-size="sm">⭐</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="997" data-end="1008">
<td data-start="997" data-end="1002" data-col-size="sm">北京</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="1002" data-end="1008">⭐⭐</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="1009" data-end="1020">
<td data-start="1009" data-end="1014" data-col-size="sm">出差</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="1014" data-end="1020">⭐⭐</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="1021" data-end="1031">
<td data-start="1021" data-end="1026" data-col-size="sm">今天</td>
<td data-col-size="sm" data-start="1026" data-end="1031">⭐</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="1033" data-end="1036">
<p data-start="1038" data-end="1058">模型不会“理解”，但它会做一件类似的事：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1060" data-end="1073">
<p data-start="1062" data-end="1073"><strong data-start="1062" data-end="1073">计算相关性分数</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1075" data-end="1078">
<h1 data-section-id="lttsz5" data-start="1080" data-end="1106">4.3 Attention 的核心思想</h1>
<p data-start="1108" data-end="1126">Attention 本质只有一句话：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1128" data-end="1169">
<p data-start="1130" data-end="1169"><strong data-start="1130" data-end="1169">当前 Token 会去“查询”前面所有 Token，并决定哪些最重要。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1171" data-end="1177">注意这句话：</p>
<ul data-start="1179" data-end="1233">
<li data-section-id="15ikrcq" data-start="1179" data-end="1196">当前 Token：正在预测的词</li>
<li data-section-id="1xpgp40" data-start="1197" data-end="1211">前面 Token：上下文</li>
<li data-section-id="24k1im" data-start="1212" data-end="1222">查询：比较相关性</li>
<li data-section-id="4nxlcs" data-start="1223" data-end="1233">最重要：权重更高</li>
</ul>
<p>核心就是下面这张图:</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/653851/202606/653851-20260630173125300-1757135932.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr data-start="1235" data-end="1238">
<h1 data-section-id="2uge1y" data-start="1240" data-end="1260">4.4 Q、K、V 按角色理解</h1>
<p data-start="1262" data-end="1283">现在我们终于可以引入 QKV，但是我们不从数学角度去理解。</p>
<hr data-start="1285" data-end="1288">
<h2 data-section-id="183ojdw" data-start="1290" data-end="1307">我们用一个简单的“会议室发言”理解 QKV</h2>
<p data-start="1309" data-end="1316">我们想象一个会议.每个人都有三种属性：</p>
<hr data-start="1330" data-end="1333">
<h3 data-section-id="1ne9jb3" data-start="1335" data-end="1350">① Key（身份标签）</h3>
<p data-start="1352" data-end="1359">每个人都会说：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1361" data-end="1372">
<p data-start="1363" data-end="1372">我是谁，我做什么的</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1374" data-end="1377">例如：</p>
<ul data-start="1379" data-end="1410">
<li data-section-id="ud355g" data-start="1379" data-end="1389">小明：后端工程师</li>
<li data-section-id="kaixv4" data-start="1390" data-end="1399">小红：产品经理</li>
<li data-section-id="1gg31zv" data-start="1400" data-end="1410">小李：数据库专家</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="1412" data-end="1415">
<h3 data-section-id="11sg4pj" data-start="1417" data-end="1433">② Query（提问者）</h3>
<p data-start="1435" data-end="1443">现在你问一句话：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1445" data-end="1456">
<p data-start="1447" data-end="1456">谁懂 Redis？</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1458" data-end="1471">这个问题就是 Query。</p>
<hr data-start="1473" data-end="1476">
<h3 data-section-id="wqr6u0" data-start="1478" data-end="1496">③ Value（真正的信息）</h3>
<p data-start="1498" data-end="1505">如果匹配成功：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1507" data-end="1519">
<p data-start="1509" data-end="1519">数据库专家站起来回答</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1521" data-end="1535">他说的内容就是 Value。</p>
<hr data-start="1537" data-end="1540">
<h2 data-section-id="1f4f1xl" data-start="1542" data-end="1559">所以Attention 的计算流程可以简单理解为：</h2>
<blockquote data-start="1561" data-end="1589">
<p data-start="1563" data-end="1589">Query 去匹配 Key，匹配成功后拿 Value</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1591" data-end="1594">
<h1 data-section-id="1v1n0xo" data-start="1596" data-end="1616">4.5 回到 Transformer</h1>
<p data-start="1618" data-end="1630">现在我们回到刚才那句话：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1632" data-end="1651">
<p data-start="1634" data-end="1651">小明昨天去北京出差，今天他回来了。</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="1653" data-end="1656">
<p data-start="1658" data-end="1667">模型内部其实在做如下步骤:</p>
<h3 data-section-id="ktr9gi" data-start="1669" data-end="1697">步骤1：每个 Token 生成 Q/K/V</h3>
<p data-start="1699" data-end="1702">例如：</p>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="1704" data-end="1802">
<thead data-start="1704" data-end="1725">
<tr data-start="1704" data-end="1725"><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="1704" data-end="1712" data-col-size="sm">Token</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="1712" data-end="1716" data-col-size="sm">Q</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="1716" data-end="1720" data-col-size="sm">K</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="1720" data-end="1725" data-col-size="sm">V</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="1747" data-end="1802">
<tr data-start="1747" data-end="1774">
<td data-start="1747" data-end="1752" data-col-size="sm">小明</td>
<td data-start="1752" data-end="1759" data-col-size="sm">查询能力</td>
<td data-start="1759" data-end="1766" data-col-size="sm">身份标签</td>
<td data-start="1766" data-end="1774" data-col-size="sm">信息内容</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="1775" data-end="1802">
<td data-start="1775" data-end="1780" data-col-size="sm">北京</td>
<td data-start="1780" data-end="1787" data-col-size="sm">查询能力</td>
<td data-start="1787" data-end="1794" data-col-size="sm">身份标签</td>
<td data-start="1794" data-end="1802" data-col-size="sm">信息内容</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="1804" data-end="1813">（不用管具体维度）</p>
<hr data-start="1815" data-end="1818">
<h3 data-section-id="186pp7c" data-start="1820" data-end="1836">步骤2：计算匹配度</h3>
<p data-start="1838" data-end="1845">“他”会去问：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1847" data-end="1859">
<p data-start="1849" data-end="1859">谁最像我在指代的人？</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1861" data-end="1864">于是：</p>
<div class="TyagGW_tableContainer">
<div class="group TyagGW_tableWrapper flex flex-col-reverse w-fit">
<table class="w-fit min-w-(--thread-content-width)" data-start="1866" data-end="1944">
<thead data-start="1866" data-end="1882">
<tr data-start="1866" data-end="1882"><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="1866" data-end="1874" data-col-size="sm">Token</th><th class="last:pe-10" data-start="1874" data-end="1882" data-col-size="sm">匹配分数</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody data-start="1903" data-end="1944">
<tr data-start="1903" data-end="1916">
<td data-start="1903" data-end="1908" data-col-size="sm">小明</td>
<td data-start="1908" data-end="1916" data-col-size="sm">0.92</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="1917" data-end="1930">
<td data-start="1917" data-end="1922" data-col-size="sm">北京</td>
<td data-start="1922" data-end="1930" data-col-size="sm">0.31</td>
</tr>
<tr data-start="1931" data-end="1944">
<td data-start="1931" data-end="1936" data-col-size="sm">昨天</td>
<td data-start="1936" data-end="1944" data-col-size="sm">0.10</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<hr data-start="1946" data-end="1949">
<h3 data-section-id="1640sng" data-start="1951" data-end="1968">步骤 3：加权汇总信息</h3>
<p data-start="1970" data-end="1982">模型不会只选一个，而是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="1984" data-end="1996">
<p data-start="1986" data-end="1996">把所有信息按权重混合</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="1998" data-end="2001">结果：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-token-bg-elevated-secondary corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>0.92 × 小明<br>0.31 × 北京<br>0.10 × 昨天</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-start="2042" data-end="2047">最终得到：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2049" data-end="2062">
<p data-start="2051" data-end="2062">“他”的语义 = 小明</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2064" data-end="2067">
<h1 data-section-id="1uip7pw" data-start="2069" data-end="2090">4.6 Attention 的本质总结</h1>
<p data-start="2092" data-end="2100">如果只记一句话：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2102" data-end="2136">
<p data-start="2104" data-end="2136"><strong data-start="2104" data-end="2136">Attention = 给所有历史信息打分 + 加权融合</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2138" data-end="2141">
<h1 data-section-id="1oogtd9" data-start="2143" data-end="2168">4.7 为什么 Attention 这么重要？</h1>
<p data-start="2170" data-end="2195">在 Transformer 出现之前，主流模型是：</p>
<ul data-start="2197" data-end="2209">
<li data-section-id="1o4tdm" data-start="2197" data-end="2202">RNN</li>
<li data-section-id="1j3vnji" data-start="2203" data-end="2209">LSTM</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="2211" data-end="2218">它们的问题是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2220" data-end="2231">
<p data-start="2222" data-end="2231">信息会“越传越弱”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2233" data-end="2236">例如：</p>
<p data-start="2238" data-end="2245">一句很长的话：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2247" data-end="2277">
<p data-start="2249" data-end="2277">我昨天在北京的一家咖啡店看到一个穿红衣服的程序员，他……</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2279" data-end="2286">模型容易忘掉：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2288" data-end="2295">
<p data-start="2290" data-end="2295">“我昨天”</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2297" data-end="2300">
<p data-start="2302" data-end="2320">Attention 解决了这个问题：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2322" data-end="2344">
<p data-start="2324" data-end="2344"><strong data-start="2324" data-end="2344">它每一步都可以直接回看全部历史信息</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2346" data-end="2349">
<h1 data-section-id="1lrfavg" data-start="2351" data-end="2366">4.8&nbsp;Attention 革命性的变化</h1>
<p data-start="2368" data-end="2389">Attention 做了一件革命性的事情：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2391" data-end="2420">
<p data-start="2393" data-end="2403">❌ 不再“顺序记忆”</p>
<p data-start="2410" data-end="2420">✅ 变成“全局检索”</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2422" data-end="2425">
<p data-start="2427" data-end="2435">你可以这样理解：</p>
<p data-start="2437" data-end="2443">以前模型是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2445" data-end="2457">
<p data-start="2447" data-end="2457">纯用脑子记（容易忘）</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2459" data-end="2465">现在模型是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2467" data-end="2480">
<p data-start="2469" data-end="2480">记下了小本本,可以随时翻整本书（随时查）</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2482" data-end="2485">
<h1 data-section-id="1kpcjsf" data-start="2487" data-end="2513">4.9 多头 Attention(多头注意力)</h1>
<p data-start="2515" data-end="2524">你可以把它理解成：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2526" data-end="2543">
<p data-start="2528" data-end="2543">一个问题，有多个“专家同时看”</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2545" data-end="2548">例如下面这句话：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2556" data-end="2564">
<p data-start="2558" data-end="2564">我在银行存钱</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2566" data-end="2573">不同头会关注：</p>
<ul data-start="2575" data-end="2602">
<li data-section-id="cp5n4" data-start="2575" data-end="2581">金融语义</li>
<li data-section-id="1wi3lz" data-start="2582" data-end="2588">语法结构</li>
<li data-section-id="1n522ys" data-start="2589" data-end="2595">指代关系</li>
<li data-section-id="1p1vk1w" data-start="2596" data-end="2602">时间信息</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="2604" data-end="2607">
<p data-start="2609" data-end="2625">所以模型不是一个人在思考，而是：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2627" data-end="2643">
<p data-start="2629" data-end="2643">多个“注意力专家”在并行工作</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2645" data-end="2648">
<h1 data-section-id="1e7izj6" data-start="2650" data-end="2663">4.10 本章核心总结</h1>
<p data-start="2665" data-end="2679">这一章最重要的内容只有四点：</p>
<hr data-start="2681" data-end="2684">
<h3 data-section-id="1mikyl1" data-start="2686" data-end="2707">① Attention 在做什么？</h3>
<blockquote data-start="2709" data-end="2730">
<p data-start="2711" data-end="2730">给每个 Token 分配“重要性权重”</p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2732" data-end="2735">
<h3 data-section-id="12wvzzn" data-start="2737" data-end="2751">② QKV 是什么？</h3>
<ul data-start="2753" data-end="2783">
<li data-section-id="138wse4" data-start="2753" data-end="2762">Q：我在问什么</li>
<li data-section-id="4aiuu6" data-start="2763" data-end="2771">K：你是什么</li>
<li data-section-id="1uz9vxl" data-start="2772" data-end="2783">V：你提供什么信息</li>
</ul>
<hr data-start="2785" data-end="2788">
<h3 data-section-id="ar5xrm" data-start="2790" data-end="2809">③ Attention 的本质</h3>
<blockquote data-start="2811" data-end="2838">
<p data-start="2813" data-end="2838"><strong data-start="1130" data-end="1169">当前 Token 会去“查询”前面所有 Token，并决定哪些最重要。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2840" data-end="2843">
<h3 data-section-id="wnfkh3" data-start="2845" data-end="2858">④ 为什么它重要？</h3>
<blockquote data-start="2860" data-end="2889">
<p data-start="2862" data-end="2889">因为它让模型可以“随时回看所有上下文”，而不是逐步遗忘<strong data-start="1130" data-end="1169">。</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<hr data-start="2891" data-end="2894">
<h1 data-section-id="r9oadf" data-start="2896" data-end="2903">下一章预告</h1>
<p data-start="2905" data-end="2922">下一章我们会讲Transformer另外一个非常核心的模块：</p>
<blockquote data-start="2924" data-end="2977">
<p data-start="2926" data-end="2977"><strong data-start="2926" data-end="2977">既然 Attention 已经这么强了，为什么还需要 Transformer 的FFN“前馈神经网络”？</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p data-start="2979" data-end="2985">&nbsp;</p>
